closeout_operational_failures.recovery: Use exact-token searches and bounded line ranges for each scaffold independently.

closeout_operational_failures.observed: The read-only probe returned path-not-found; the actual x1 packet uses new-proposal-freeze.json and proposal-chain-audit.json.
closeout_operational_failures.recovery: List the exact x1 paths first and read only the materialized filenames.

startup_and_x1_failures.recovery: Parse the full 149-kilobyte JSON locally and project only exact keys, counts, and method identifiers.

startup_and_x1_failures.failed_witness: A PowerShell foreach result was piped before materialization and the parser rejected the expression.

startup_and_x1_failures.failed_witness: The full authorization current-state display exceeded its bounded output window.
startup_and_x1_failures.recovery: Read the same exact file in bounded numbered chunks through EOF.

startup_and_x1_failures.recovery: Inspect the receipt's actual keys, then project the real detailed, minimal, and test fields.

startup_and_x1_failures.failed_witness: The absent Tamar remote branch returned no rows and the preflight wrapper called Trim on null.
startup_and_x1_failures.recovery: Materialize zero returned rows explicitly and preserve absence as the expected branch-creation precondition.

startup_and_x1_failures.failed_witness: The authorized worktree creation crossed its display boundary and the wrapper omitted the running session handle.
startup_and_x1_failures.recovery: Do not rerun the mutation; inspect exact Git processes, locks, and the eventual registered worktree until quiescent.

startup_and_x1_failures.failed_witness: A Wait-Process already-gone result collapsed into the wrapper's timeout catch.
startup_and_x1_failures.recovery: Verify an exact zero process count and inspect the created branch and worktree directly.

startup_and_x1_failures.failed_witness: The first worktree-registration comparison treated Git forward slashes and Windows backslashes as different paths.
startup_and_x1_failures.recovery: Normalize only path separators and compare the exact registered absolute path.

startup_and_x1_failures.failed_witness: The first planning-only materialization quarantined proposal 060 because its title had token Jaccard 0.833333 against an inherited Māori-authority title.
startup_and_x1_failures.recovery: Change only proposal 060's title to a seed-library cultural-governance reservation with distinct wording, then rerun the complete bounded novelty audit.

startup_and_x1_failures.failed_witness: The first staged-manifest replay diagnostic escaped CR and LF byte literals as textual backslash sequences and falsely reported two-byte mismatches in the builder and test.
startup_and_x1_failures.recovery: Use actual CR and LF byte constants on one literal path per invocation; worktree and staged Git-blob bytes then matched exactly.

startup_and_x1_failures.failed_witness: The first bounded byte-difference recovery had an unterminated Python string literal and exited before inspecting either file.
startup_and_x1_failures.recovery: Remove the nested executable string and inspect one literal path per invocation with a short direct expression.

x2_operational_failures.false_witness: A grouped git cat-file command could be assigned inside one PowerShell expression while preserving its exit code.
x2_operational_failures.observed: PowerShell raised a missing-closing-parenthesis parser fault before reading any source object or changing repository state.
x2_operational_failures.recovery: Run each read-only git cat-file probe separately, capture its scalar exit code, and materialize the result only after the command returns.

x2_operational_failures.false_witness: Sequential proposal positions would keep every owner-local skill name semantically aligned with its smoke fixture.
x2_operational_failures.observed: The complete-read review found wheel and seed skill names paired with stained-glass proposals because the first scaffold used indexes 1 through 20.
x2_operational_failures.recovery: Retain the official initialization, map all twenty skills to distinct semantically matching proposal indexes, and rewrite only customized skill content plus the skill-bank mapping.

x2_operational_failures.false_witness: One combined display could prove all twenty generated SKILL.md files were read through EOF.
x2_operational_failures.observed: The display truncated around skills 10 and 11, so the combined read earned no complete-read credit.
x2_operational_failures.recovery: After semantic refresh, read the twenty complete skills in four bounded five-file groups and require each group to reach EOF.

x2_operational_failures.false_witness: The first multi-surface semantic-refresh patch matched the copied receipt field order.
x2_operational_failures.observed: apply_patch rejected the edit on a missing context line before changing either the builder or evidence test.
x2_operational_failures.recovery: Inspect the exact line order and apply small contextual patches for mapping, refresh behavior, retained failures, counts, CLI routing, and tests.

x2_operational_failures.false_witness: Four individually bounded five-skill reads could be parallelized inside one aggregate display without losing EOF evidence.
x2_operational_failures.observed: The outer aggregate truncated the middle two groups even though each nested command had its own bound.
x2_operational_failures.recovery: Read groups 06 through 10 and 11 through 15 in separate sequential tool results; combine those with the complete 01 through 05 and 16 through 20 results.

x2_operational_failures.false_witness: A wildcard runner path passed directly to rg would expand on the active Windows command surface.
x2_operational_failures.observed: rg rejected the literal asterisk path with an invalid filename error after the other stale-label targets were scanned.
x2_operational_failures.recovery: Materialize the ten exact runner paths with Get-ChildItem and pass those literal paths to the runner-only stale-label scan.
